title: OSCORE context activation: tests missing register_fresh() call
description:
## Root Cause
The OSCORE context exported from EDHOC is created via `Context::new_fresh()` which explicitly sets `active = false` (line 241 in context.rs). The `reserve_sender()` method checks `if !self.active { return Err(ReservationError::Conflict); }` (line 87-88 in protect.rs). The tests create a TestStore but never call `register_fresh()` to activate the context with the store. Without activation, reserve_sender immediately fails with Conflict.

## Affected Tests
- test_full_handshake (lines 912-913)
- test_prk_oscore_interop_vectors (line 1158)
- test_full_handshake_e2e_roundtrip (around line 1153)

## Location
/Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore/src/edhoc/tests.rs

## Suggested Fix
After creating TestStore, call register_fresh() on the exported contexts to activate them. Replace lines 912-913 with:

```rust
let mut initiator_store = TestStore::empty_for(&initiator_ctx);
let mut responder_store = TestStore::empty_for(&responder_ctx);
let mut initiator_ctx = initiator_ctx
    .register_fresh(&mut initiator_store)
    .expect("initiator register_fresh failed");
let mut responder_ctx = responder_ctx
    .register_fresh(&mut responder_store)
    .expect("responder register_fresh failed");
```

The same fix is needed for test_full_handshake_e2e_roundtrip and test_prk_oscore_interop_vectors.

## Error Type
Missing activation step - tests fail with ReservationError::Conflict
